about.doctor: Nazar {version} — empty canvas? Run {command} in a terminal.
about.jump: Double-click a card or press {enter} to bring its terminal to the front.
agent.label: subagent {type}, {activity}, state {state}, depth {depth}
canvas.label: Live canvas of running Claude Code sessions and their subagents
card.captureBlocked: cost/context: this project overrides the status line
card.captureBlockedNote: This project sets its own "statusLine" key, which replaces the user-level status line for every session started here — so the nazar-statusline wrapper never runs and writes no capture. Point that statusLine at nazar-statusline too, or remove the key. "nazar doctor" prints the exact file and the exact key.
card.menuLabel: card actions: move this session to a tab
card.renameNote: Click to name this card. The name is kept by this browser only — it is never sent anywhere and never written to your session.
card.renameNoteSet: Click to rename this card, or clear the field to go back to the folder name. The name is kept by this browser only.
card.resizeCorner: Drag a corner to scale this card, keeping its proportions. The subagent tree wraps to the new width; the card cannot be made smaller than the tree that is showing.
card.resizeEdge: Drag an edge to change one dimension: top and bottom set the height, left and right set the width. The opposite edge of the card stays where it is.
colour.contrastLow: {ratio}:1 against the card — below the 3:1 minimum for a ring, so it may be hard to see
colour.contrastPasses: {ratio}:1 against the card — clears the 3:1 minimum for a ring
empty.hint: start {command} in a terminal — the canvas fills itself in about a second
empty.next.noConfigDir: check CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR if you moved it, then run nazar doctor
empty.next.noSessions: start a session in a terminal — the canvas fills within a second
empty.next.staleSessions: these are sessions that ended; start a new one, or run nazar doctor to see them
empty.noteAgents: claude agents did not answer, so there is no second opinion on liveness
empty.noteWrapper: the status-line wrapper is not installed, so cost and context stay unknown
empty.tabHint: move a session here from the {menu} menu on its card, or drag the card onto this tab
empty.title: no sessions found
empty.why.noConfigDir: the sessions directory does not exist, so Claude Code has never run under this configuration directory
empty.why.noSessions: Claude Code writes one file per live session and there is none right now
empty.why.staleSessions: session files exist, but no process behind them is alive
hint.allHaveChildren: nothing to clear: every finished subagent here still has a running one under it
hint.autoTabsOff: folders no longer get a tab on their own; the ones you have stay
hint.autoTabsOn: new folders get a tab from now on — existing sessions are taken on the next frame
hint.autostartFailed: the startup entry could not be changed
hint.cleared.few: {count} finished subagents hidden — nothing was deleted; the chip on the card brings them back
hint.cleared.one: {count} finished subagent hidden — nothing was deleted; the chip on the card brings them back
hint.cleared.other: {count} finished subagents hidden — nothing was deleted; the chip on the card brings them back
hint.followsRules: this card now follows the rules
hint.frozenNoMenu: a finished session is on screen — go back to live for a card menu
hint.frozenNoNames: a finished session is a read of the past; names live on the live canvas
hint.frozenNoNotes: a finished session is a read of the past; notes live on the live canvas
hint.frozenNoTerminal: this session has ended; there is no terminal to jump to
hint.inABrowser: this is Nazar in a browser tab
hint.nameCleared: name cleared — back to the folder
hint.noneFinished: nothing to clear: no subagent on this card has finished
hint.recordingFailed: the desktop shell could not change the recording mode
hint.shellSilent: the desktop shell did not answer
hint.tabExists: {name} already has a tab — showing it
hint.tabNeedsAName: name the session with /rename and its tab can be found
history.closeLabel: Close history and return to the live canvas
history.counts: {shown} of {total} sessions · {projects} projects · listed in {ms} ms
history.empty: no past sessions on disk — Claude Code keeps transcripts for cleanupPeriodDays
history.gone: that session is no longer on disk
history.openFailed: that session could not be read
history.title: History
history.unreadable: the transcript store could not be read
menu.clearFinishedNote: hide the subagents that have finished. Nothing is deleted: a chip on the card brings them back, and the history view is unaffected
menu.clearNameNote: go back to the folder this session is running in
menu.collapseNote: fold the whole tree away to a row of summary chips
menu.followProjectNote: stop pinning this card and let the project that owns its folder have it
menu.hasTabNote: {folder} already has a tab — show it
menu.jumpNote: bring the terminal running this session to the front (or double-click the card)
menu.moveToFolder: folder tab: every session in {folder}. Moving this card here pins it
menu.name: Name this card…
menu.nameNote: the name is kept by this browser only
menu.openTabNote: every session in {folder} lands on one tab, live and in history
menu.renameTerminalHint: Rename the terminal too: type /rename <name> in that session
menu.resetSizeNote: let this card size itself around its tree again, on both axes
needsYou.badgeLabel.few: {count} sessions are waiting for you, the longest for {duration}. Activate to list them.
needsYou.badgeLabel.one: {count} session is waiting for you, for {duration}. Activate to list it.
needsYou.badgeLabel.other: {count} sessions are waiting for you, the longest for {duration}. Activate to list them.
needsYou.finishedRow: {name} in {folder} finished {ago}. Activate to go to its card.
needsYou.row: {name} in {folder} — waiting for {what}, {duration} so far. Activate to go to its card.
needsYou.title: Needs you
note.label: note: {text}
settings.autoTabsNote: when on, the first session Nazar sees in a folder opens a tab for that folder. Off by default: on a machine with forty repositories this is forty tabs
settings.coloursNote: Ring colour per activity. Below 3:1 contrast a ring is hard to see.
settings.languageNote: English and Turkish were written by hand; the other four were machine-translated first. Corrections are welcome as pull requests.
settings.recording: recording mode: never read task text
settings.recordingNote: switches task text off for this machine rather than for this browser: Nazar restarts its reader with --no-task-text, so no transcript text is read at all. This is the one to use while recording or sharing a screen.
settings.taskTextNote: Read from the transcript, never written to disk, kept in this browser only.
settings.title: Settings
sidebar.closeTab: close the {name} tab. The folder is not touched
sidebar.countPastNote: read the transcript store once, so each folder tab can say how many past sessions it has
sidebar.noFolderNote: {label} — Nazar never saw a working directory for this session
sidebar.noFolderTabs: No folder tabs yet. Right-click a session in the sidebar and open a tab for its folder.
sidebar.noSessions: No sessions on the canvas yet.
sidebar.pastCounted.few: {count} past sessions in the transcript store
sidebar.pastCounted.one: {count} past session in the transcript store
sidebar.pastCounted.other: {count} past sessions in the transcript store
sidebar.pastUncounted: past sessions have not been counted yet
tab.close: remove the {name} tab; its sessions go back to All
tab.closeFolder: close the {name} tab; its sessions go back to All. The folder is not touched
tray.tooltip: Nazar — a watchful eye on your agents
usage.explainer: How much of your Claude / Codex plan is used in the current 5-hour and weekly windows.
usage.howTo: how to get usage limits, cost and context
usage.sourceNone: none — install the wrapper or nazar-tray
usage.title: Usage limits
